entities.name: Thomas Conrad von Baldenstein

entities.summary: Thomas Conrad von Baldenstein was a Swiss ornithologist, entomologist and apiarist. He produced a number of scientific works on the birdlife of the Alps, and was the first to describe the willow tit.
